{{Quote|She carries stones for Whuddle's animal pens. For twenty hours she carries stones. Then she dies and I bring her here so she is not animal food.|Feb'Noota|<ref name="Mother" />}}
'''Diida''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] who was a [[Parent/Legends|mother]] to two daughters, [[Vette|Ce'na]] and [[Tivva]]. Born in [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]], the daughters were separated from their mother at a young age. During the [[Galactic War]] the sisters found each other after long [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of separation and were encouraged to find their mother as well. However, by the time Tivva learned that their mother was owned by [[Whuddle]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and traveled to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to find her, she found only her corpse. [[Feb'Noota]] arranged her funeral, which both Tivva and Ce'na attended.
